cases.oracle: Independent private module/policy fixtures, guarded owned argv-recording command, explicitly expected plan, util-linux kmod modprobe --show-depends on a separately copied real guest module, and seccomp controls that prevent module syscalls.
cases.comparison: Setup proves all three module syscalls are denied before the kernel and exercises a guarded owned command with exit 0 and 7. Candidate policy, dry-run plans, alias blacklist, cycle/depth errors and non-dry install/remove directives use only private files and the owned command. A separate reference case copies one dependency-free guest module into a private tree, builds a private depmod index and compares its --show-depends output. Every attempted module syscall is recorded and fails the no-module assertion; real kernel module effects are not simulated as success. A guarded precompiled listener records its bootstrap stages for each notification trace.
cases.purpose: Inspect private policy, softdep order, chain/options, reverse removal, blacklist and graph errors.
cases.stdout: kmod-policy projection=yes softdep=yes chain=yes reverse=yes remove=yes blacklist=yes graph=yes
